SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS loan_count, CONVERT(varchar(40), CAST(SUM(loan_amnt) AS decimal(38,2))) AS requested_total, CONVERT(varchar(40), CAST(SUM(funded_amnt) AS decimal(38,2))) AS funded_total, CONVERT(varchar(40), CAST(AVG(loan_amnt) AS decimal(20,6))) AS requested_avg, CONVERT(varchar(40), CAST(AVG(funded_amnt) AS decimal(20,6))) AS funded_avg FROM loans_fact

SELECT a.application_type, COUNT_BIG(*) AS loan_count, CAST(100.0 * COUNT_BIG(*) / SUM(COUNT_BIG(*)) OVER () AS decimal(10,4)) AS portfolio_pct FROM loans_fact l JOIN application_type_dim a ON l.application_type_id = a.application_type_id GROUP BY a.application_type ORDER BY loan_count DESC

roles.query: SELECT i.year, COUNT_BIG(*) AS loan_count, CAST(AVG(l.funded_amnt) AS decimal(20,6)) AS avg_funded_amnt, CAST(AVG(l.int_rate) * 100 AS decimal(12,6)) AS avg_int_rate_pct FROM loans_fact l JOIN issue_d_dim i ON l.issue_d_id = i.issue_d_id GROUP BY i.year ORDER BY i.year

SELECT h.home_ownership, COUNT_BIG(*) AS loan_count, CAST(AVG(l.funded_amnt) AS decimal(20,6)) AS avg_funded_amnt, CAST(AVG(l.int_rate) * 100 AS decimal(12,6)) AS avg_int_rate_pct, CAST(AVG(l.dti) AS decimal(12,6)) AS avg_dti FROM loans_fact l JOIN home_ownership_dim h ON l.home_ownership_id = h.home_ownership_id GROUP BY h.home_ownership ORDER BY loan_count DESC
